g.text: LP and GP cash flows carry different risks
IRR and NPV change with growth and timing
Capital committed before returns are realised
Fixed fees support part of GP income; they do not eliminate GP risk.
Q3 in one line: the LP's return depends on growth and timing; the GP has a fixed fee plus performance-linked carry,its own capital at risk and costs to cover.
Source: Q3 Analysis!A34:G40; Q3 Base case!B41:L46; Case pp. 4–5. TPG's co-investment return is not modelled separately; no risk probabilities are estimated.
